scope: 100-point candidate audit. Ordering after the nine qualified changes is a profiling backlog, not an evidence-backed ranking.

method: Savings above describe controlled integration-test allocation budgets or complexity, not measured whole-drive improvements. Unknown candidates are not classified as zero/low risk. Estimates must not be added together.

rows.risk: low; public correctness and allocation regressions pass
rows.estimated_savings: Eliminate one full FileRecord/DirectoryRecord vector; local 20k fixture reduces cumulative allocations by at least 2,000,716 bytes.
rows.evidence: src/WinBlaze.Index/tests/performance.rs::building_sorted_tree_does_not_duplicate_the_record_array

rows.risk: low; public correctness and allocation regressions pass
rows.estimated_savings: Local 20k/limit10 fixture saves at least 2,301,388 allocated bytes; end-to-end CPU savings unmeasured.
rows.evidence: src/WinBlaze.Index/tests/performance.rs::limited_search_materializes_only_returned_records

rows.risk: low; public correctness and allocation regressions pass
rows.estimated_savings: Eliminate at least 1,013,700 allocated bytes per local 20k export; reduces per-row allocation to zero.
rows.evidence: src/WinBlaze.Index/tests/performance.rs::csv_export_streams_paths_without_per_record_allocations

rows.candidate: Return immediately for search limit zero
rows.risk: low; public correctness and allocation regressions pass
rows.estimated_savings: Eliminate 1,228,898 allocated bytes in the local 20k fixture; skip the entire scan/sort.
rows.evidence: src/WinBlaze.Index/tests/performance.rs::zero_result_limit_skips_catalog_work

rows.risk: low; public correctness and allocation regressions pass
rows.estimated_savings: Retained cache falls from 400,000 to under 70,000 bytes for 100k files; once-per-cache shrink may cost time.
rows.evidence: src/WinBlaze.Index/tests/performance.rs::largest_file_cache_retains_only_its_bounded_result_order

rows.candidate: Select and sort only requested textual search prefix
rows.risk: low; public correctness and allocation regressions pass
rows.estimated_savings: Local 20k fixture saves at least 65,314 allocated bytes; O(N + K log K) selection replaces full sorting for limited text queries.
rows.evidence: src/WinBlaze.Index/tests/performance.rs::limited_text_sort_avoids_keys_for_every_match_and_preserves_order

rows.candidate: Skip search when no record types are selected
rows.risk: low; public correctness and allocation regressions pass
rows.estimated_savings: Eliminate 103 allocated bytes plus catalog traversal in the local fixture.
rows.evidence: src/WinBlaze.Index/tests/performance.rs::search_without_selected_record_types_does_no_work

rows.candidate: Write short startup log lines in one operation
rows.risk: low; real Windows I/O and UTF-8/CRLF regression passes
rows.estimated_savings: 10 short lines require 10 rather than 20 WriteFile calls (50% fewer); whole-app startup saving unmeasured.
rows.evidence: tests/native/logging-io.cpp: RED 20 operations; GREEN 10 operations and exact contents

rows.candidate: Stabilize directory IDs before path-matched incremental diffs
rows.risk: low; public repository regressions cover changed IDs, modifications, new directories, dangling parents
rows.estimated_savings: Avoid a false move record and lineage for each unchanged file whose parent ID changes; the observed tiny rescan generated 48 false moves. Timing saving unmeasured.
rows.evidence: src/WinBlaze.Index/tests/incremental.rs: RED two changes instead of one; GREEN one real modification, then zero changes
